_about: Player levels and where XP comes from. Level n needs firstLevelXp*(n-1) + extraPerLevelXp*(n-1)(n-2)/2 total XP.

xp._about: XP for each thing you do. repeatKillMs: killing the same player again inside this window is worth half as much each time. idleAfterMs: time-alive XP stops this long after you last moved or did anything (and never counts inside a safe camp or the fair).
